description: Staff report IT problems and the support team works through them.
data: issues with a title, a description, a priority (low, medium or high) and a status (open, in progress or resolved)
actions: staff see all issues and a single issue
the support team starts work on an issue
the support team resolves an issue
rules: an issue goes from open to in progress to resolved, and a resolved issue can be reopened
the priority must be low, medium or high
